combat_hint: Choose ATTACK to strike with your weapon.
intro: I'm telling you, something lives behind that boulder.
I heard it last night... a wet, slapping sound.
You heard a fish flopping in the creek. Sit down.
missing_item: Grab that branch, at least! Are you crazy?!
reveal: Niko is nowhere to be seen.
A fat, hissing frog the size of a cat stares back at you.
Its amber eyes catch the fading sunlight.
The Vatrachos puffs up and lunges!
victory: It JUMPED at me! What was I supposed to do?!
Is it gone? I heard croaking-- are you both alive?
Kallinos chased it off. With a stick.
